versions.changelog:
Initial release for finding and recruiting marketing professionals on Twitter.

- Discover marketing professionals, growth specialists, and executive candidates using Twitter scrape via Apify.
- Automatically extracts handle, name, specialty, followers, content signals, and open-to-work indicators.
- Includes detailed workflow: sourcing, enrichment, candidate scoring, and filtering for company/bot accounts.
- Supports custom search terms, scoring logic, profile enrichment, and output formats (CSV, JSON).
- Useful for hiring managers, growth-stage startups, and recruiting firms seeking marketing talent.
